CURRENT_INTERPRETATION: Commitment staleness is real, but the h=1 repair did not restore specialization. Trace analysis revealed a larger unisolated action-interface divergence: carrying agents are forced to exact-home behaviour and cannot reproduce the teacher's evasive carrier motion. This axis is now the next mechanistic target.

WHY_THE_H1_REPAIR_FAILED_precise_mechani.headline: delta_A did NOT collapse because GUARD degraded. It collapsed because BREACH@A improved.
WHY_THE_H1_REPAIR_FAILED_precise_mechani.reading: GUARD@A is statistically unchanged. BREACH@A improved by +0.458 with a CI excluding zero. The entire delta_A collapse is that one cell moving up, so any hypothesis about GUARD being degraded cannot be the explanation.

H1_commitment_blocking.verdict: real but small. NOTE: the pre-registered suspect GO_HOME<->GO_TO appears only in GUARD (3.3% of ticks) and is ENTIRELY ABSENT from BREACH. Since BREACH@A is the cell that moved, GO_HOME<->GO_TO cannot explain the delta_A collapse. The dominant blocked transition in both strategies is GO_TO->GET_FLAG.

H2_carrier_substitution.verdict: BREACH's non-carrying behaviour is reproduced essentially perfectly (p90 = 0.00). EVERY material divergence in BREACH is on carrying ticks -- 20% of its ticks, diverging by up to 14 cells in a 20x20 arena. BREACH's value is grab-flag-and-return, so replacing the teacher's tangent evasion with a straight beeline home is the kind of change that could produce +0.458.

STATUS_OF_THE_CARRIER_AXIS: CANDIDATE, NOT ESTABLISHED. The trace shows a large divergence concentrated exactly where BREACH's value comes from, which is consistent with the observed improvement, but consistency is not causation. CARRIER_RESTORE_TEST is the controlled test.
WHAT_IS_NOT_A_CONFOUND: The carrier override is NOT an artifact of the oracle harness. _build_targets_from_action hard-overrides any carrying agent to exact home on the action path, so a REAL learned student cannot express carrier evasion either. It is a genuine property of the student action interface, which is why it is worth repairing rather than merely correcting for.
